286: struct_with_invariants!{
287:     struct Queue<T> {
288:         buffer: Vec<PCell<T>>,
289:         head: AtomicU64<_, FifoQueue::head<T>, _>,
290:         tail: AtomicU64<_, FifoQueue::tail<T>, _>,
291: 
292:         instance: Tracked<FifoQueue::Instance<T>>,
293:     }
294: 
295:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
296:         predicate {
297:             &&& self.instance@.backing_cells().len() == self.buffer@.len()
298:             &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i && i < self.buffer@.len() as int ==>
299:                 self.instance@.backing_cells().index(i) ==
300:                     self.buffer@.index(i).id()
301:         }
302: 
303:         invariant on head with (instance) is (v: u64, g: FifoQueue::head<T>) {
304:             &&& g.instance_id() == instance@.id()
305:             &&& g.value() == v as int
306:         }
307: 
308:         invariant on tail with (instance) is (v: u64, g: FifoQueue::tail<T>) {
309:             &&& g.instance_id() == instance@.id()
310:             &&& g.value() == v as int
311:         }
312:     }
313: }
314: 
315: pub struct Producer<T> {
316:     queue: Arc<Queue<T>>,
317:     tail: usize,
318:     producer: Tracked<FifoQueue::producer<T>>,
319: }
320: 
321: impl<T> Producer<T> {
322:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
323:         (*self.queue).wf()
324:             && self.producer@.instance_id() == (*self.queue).instance@.id()
325:             && self.producer@.value() == ProducerState::Idle(self.tail as nat)
326:             && (self.tail as int) < (*self.queue).buffer@.len()
327:     }
328: }
329: 
330: pub struct Consumer<T> {
331:     queue: Arc<Queue<T>>,
332:     head: usize,
333:     consumer: Tracked<FifoQueue::consumer<T>>,
334: }
335: 
336: impl<T> Consumer<T> {
337:     pub closed spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
338:         (*self.queue).wf()
339:             && self.consumer@.instance_id() == (*self.queue).instance@.id()
340:             && self.consumer@.value() == ConsumerState::Idle(self.head as nat)
341:             && (self.head as int) < (*self.queue).buffer@.len()
342:     }
343: }
344: 
345: pub fn new_queue<T>(len: usize) -> (pc: (Producer<T>, Consumer<T>))
346:     requires
347:         len > 0,
348:     ensures
349:         pc.0.wf(),
350:         pc.1.wf(),
351: {
352:     let mut backing_cells_vec = Vec::<PCell<T>>::new();
353:     let tracked mut perms = Map::<nat, cell::PointsTo<T>>::tracked_empty();
354:     while backing_cells_vec.len() < len
355:         invariant
356:             forall|j: nat|
357:                 #![trigger( perms.dom().contains(j) )]
358:                 #![trigger( backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int) )]
359:                 #![trigger( perms.index(j) )]
360:                 0 <= j && j < backing_cells_vec.len() as int ==> perms.dom().contains(j)
361:                     && backing_cells_vec@.index(j as int).id() == perms.index(j).id()
362:                     && perms.index(j).is_uninit(),
363:     {
364:         let ghost i = backing_cells_vec.len();
365:         let (cell, cell_perm) = PCell::empty();
366:         backing_cells_vec.push(cell);
367:         proof {
368:             perms.tracked_insert(i as nat, cell_perm.get());
369:         }
370:         assert(perms.dom().contains(i as nat));
371:         assert(backing_cells_vec@.index(i as int).id() == perms.index(i as nat).id());
372:         assert(perms.index(i as nat).is_uninit());
373:     }
374: 
375:     let ghost mut backing_cells_ids = Seq::<CellId>::new(
376:         backing_cells_vec@.len(),
377:         |i: int| backing_cells_vec@.index(i).id(),
378:     );
379:     let tracked (
380:         Tracked(instance),
381:         Tracked(head_token),
382:         Tracked(tail_token),
383:         Tracked(producer_token),
384:         Tracked(consumer_token),
385:     ) = FifoQueue::Instance::initialize(backing_cells_ids, perms, perms);
386:     let tracked_inst: Tracked<FifoQueue::Instance<T>> = Tracked(instance.clone());
387:     let head_atomic = AtomicU64::new(Ghost(tracked_inst), 0, Tracked(head_token));
388:     let tail_atomic = AtomicU64::new(Ghost(tracked_inst), 0, Tracked(tail_token));
389:     let queue = Queue::<T> {
390:         instance: Tracked(instance),
391:         head: head_atomic,
392:         tail: tail_atomic,
393:         buffer: backing_cells_vec,
394:     };
395:     let queue_arc = Arc::new(queue);
396:     let prod = Producer::<T> {
397:         queue: queue_arc.clone(),
398:         tail: 0,
399:         producer: Tracked(producer_token),
400:     };
401:     let cons = Consumer::<T> { queue: queue_arc, head: 0, consumer: Tracked(consumer_token) };
402:     (prod, cons)
403: }

405: impl<T> Producer<T> {
406:     fn enqueue(&mut self, t: T)
407:         requires
408:             old(self).wf(),
409:         ensures
410:             final(self).wf(),
411:     {
412:         loop
413:             invariant
414:                 self.wf(),
415:         {
416:             let queue = &*self.queue;
417:             let len = queue.buffer.len();
418:             assert(0 <= self.tail && self.tail < len);
419:             let next_tail = if self.tail + 1 == len {
420:                 0
421:             } else {
422:                 self.tail + 1
423:             };
424:             let tracked cell_perm: Option<cell::PointsTo<T>>;
425:             let head =
426:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.head => load();
427:                 returning head;
428:                 ghost head_token => {
429:                     cell_perm = if head != next_tail as u64 {
430:                         let tracked cp = queue.instance.borrow().produce_start(&head_token, self.producer.borrow_mut());
431:                         Option::Some(cp)
432:                     } else {
433:                         Option::None
434:                     };
435:                 }
436:             );
437:             if head != next_tail as u64 {
438:                 let tracked mut cell_perm = match cell_perm {
439:                     Option::Some(cp) => cp,
440:                     Option::None => {
441:                         assert(false);
442:                         proof_from_false()
443:                     },
444:                 };
445:                 queue.buffer[self.tail].put(Tracked(&mut cell_perm), t);
446:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.tail => store(next_tail as u64); ghost tail_token => {
447:                     queue.instance.borrow().produce_end(cell_perm,
448:                         cell_perm, &mut tail_token, self.producer.borrow_mut());
449:                 });
450:                 self.tail = next_tail;
451:                 return ;
452:             }
453:         }
454:     }
455: }

457: impl<T> Consumer<T> {
458:     fn dequeue(&mut self) -> (t: T)
459:         requires
460:             old(self).wf(),
461:         ensures
462:             final(self).wf(),
463:     {
464:         loop
465:             invariant
466:                 self.wf(),
467:         {
468:             let queue = &*self.queue;
469:             let len = queue.buffer.len();
470:             assert(0 <= self.head && self.head < len);
471:             let next_head = if self.head + 1 == len {
472:                 0
473:             } else {
474:                 self.head + 1
475:             };
476:             let tracked cell_perm: Option<cell::PointsTo<T>>;
477:             let tail =
478:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.tail => load();
479:                 returning tail;
480:                 ghost tail_token => {
481:                     cell_perm = if self.head as u64 != tail {
482:                         let tracked (_, Tracked(cp)) = queue.instance.borrow().consume_start(&tail_token, self.consumer.borrow_mut());
483:                         Option::Some(cp)
484:                     } else {
485:                         Option::None
486:                     };
487:                 }
488:             );
489:             if self.head as u64 != tail {
490:                 let tracked mut cell_perm = match cell_perm {
491:                     Option::Some(cp) => cp,
492:                     Option::None => {
493:                         assert(false);
494:                         proof_from_false()
495:                     },
496:                 };
497:                 let t = queue.buffer[self.head].take(Tracked(&mut cell_perm));
498:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.head => store(next_head as u64); ghost head_token => {
499:                     queue.instance.borrow().consume_end(cell_perm,
500:                         cell_perm, &mut head_token, self.consumer.borrow_mut());
501:                 });
502:                 self.head = next_head;
503:                 return t;
504:             }
505:         }
506:     }
